verification.notes: Real `claude -p` sessions 2026-09-25: startup and resume both fired the hook (session_source observed as startup and resume) and the agent quoted the payload. clear/compact/fork not provoked; documented only. No matcher is set, so every source fires.

limitations: Exit code 2 from a SessionStart hook blocks session start; the adapter therefore only ever exits 0 or 1.
On resume the hook fires, but delivery cannot be told apart from context already in the resumed transcript.
Adapter files are governance machinery: a change goes through the Solution Designer.
